title: Agent teams plugin configuration
description: Per-plugin (global) limits, rates, timeouts and TTLs for the agent-teams plugin. All caps are read via ctx.getPluginConfig. See change: add-agent-teams-core.

maxTeammates.description: Maximum teammates per team (clamped into 1-10). Counted synchronously before any await.

maxActiveTeams.description: Maximum concurrently active teams across the server.

maxTasks.description: Maximum NON-completed tasks per team (task ids keep increasing).

maxMessageChars.description: Maximum characters in one mail text (UTF-16 units).

maxResultChars.description: Maximum characters in a task result (truncation marker appended).

maxFinalTextChars.description: Maximum characters of a teammate's final text carried in the idle report.

mailRatePerMin.description: Per-sender mail rate limit (token bucket, mails per minute).

pairExchangeLimit.description: Per-pair loop breaker: mails between the same two members with no task state change in between before rate_limited.

maxMailLogBytes.description: Mail-log size (bytes) that triggers compaction (keeps every unacked entry plus the newest until at most 50% of the cap).

closedRetentionDays.description: Days a closed team file is kept before pruning at startup.

wakeConfirmMs.description: Provisional-busy confirmation window after a waking mail.

urgentSettleWaitMs.description: How long an urgent mail waits for the aborted member's settle report before emitting.

notifyCoalesceMs.description: Window over which lead notices are coalesced into one agent-teams-notice mail.

spawnTimeoutMs.description: Bind + guarded hello + start-prompt ack deadline for a newly started member.

shutdownGraceMs.description: Grace for a member's final turn after an approved shutdown before the host shutdown call.

reconcileGraceMs.description: Startup wait for hello/onSessionResolved re-binds before reconciling members as disconnected.

orphanTtlMs.description: A lead absent this long closes the team (closeReason orphan_ttl); sessions are left untouched.

opGateBudgetMs.description: Total budget for registered op gates per call (must stay inside the 15 s lane timeout).

maxTemplateBytes.description: Maximum size (bytes) of a team template file; larger files are listed invalid (template_too_large).

hookTimeoutMs.description: Default per-command hook timeout; always capped by the remaining op-gate budget (opGateBudgetMs). Invalid values fall back to the default.

hookMaxRetries.description: Consecutive TeammateIdle hook blocks per member before the idle is accepted and the lead is notified. 0 means idle hooks never block. Invalid values fall back to the default.

planMaxChars.description: Maximum characters of a submitted plan (also bounds a plan decision's feedback). The effective cap is min(planMaxChars, maxMessageChars - 500) and 120 lines. Invalid values fall back to the default.

planModeTools.description: Tools a member keeps while its plan is awaiting approval (read-only set). bash, edit, write and unknown names are dropped with a startup warning.

autoDispatch.description: Automatically hand pending tasks to idle members. Per-team override in Team.overrides.

blockSleepPolling.description: Teammate guard refuses a bash command that only sleeps for 10 s or more (nothing to claim: end the turn instead of busy-waiting). Advisory.

blockGitWrite.description: Teammate guard refuses git commit/push/reset --hard/rebase/merge while the lead is the team's committer. Advisory while bash is allowed.

extraCwdRoots.description: Additional absolute directory roots a per-member cwd may live under, besides the lead's cwd.

openspecGroupParallel.description: openspec-group: changes shipped in parallel (clamped into 1..effective maxTeammates; non-integers use the default).

openspecShipSkill.description: openspec-group: skill the teammate loads first (lowercase letters, digits, dashes, at most 64 characters).

openspecReviewSkill.description: openspec-apply: skill of the reviewer teammate (lowercase letters, digits, dashes, at most 64 characters).

openspecWorktreeBase.description: openspec-group: branch a new change worktree forks from (a valid git branch name, never starting with a dash).

openspecMergeBase.description: openspec-group: branch the ship skill merges into; the completion gate looks for the archive there (a valid git branch name).

openspecLockTtlMs.description: ResourceLock: a holder that never releases loses the lock after this long (clamped into 60000..86400000).

openspecFetchTimeoutMs.description: openspec-group completion gate: bound of `git fetch origin <merge>` (clamped to at most 10000; below 1 or non-integer uses the default).

teammateMode.description: Default teammate mode for TeamCreate when no mode is given. Unset resolves to "session". Must name a registered mode.
